integrity: Proof and numerical verifier are included; the proof is analytic and the finite checks are supplementary, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The exact tensor assumes force-free planar Brownian motion with a constant symmetric positive-definite body mobility and instantaneous orientation-only Poisson resets to one angle.
The universal peak and principal-axis switch require the isotropic-Schur subfamily and nonzero translation-rotation coupling; they are not claimed for arbitrary anisotropic conditional mobility.
No active propulsion, non-Markovian rotational dynamics, finite reset duration, or spatial reset is included.
Priority against all potentially related full-text literature has not been independently established.
title: Poissonian orientation resets invert the diffusion axes of a thermally coupled colloid
